title: Synal placement/browser extension for Signal Composer

observed_existing_assets.github_repo_search: No indexed Synal repository or Synal/signal/browser/place source assets found via connector search at time of enqueue.
observed_existing_assets.reuse_anchor: Use parent Signal Composer job as canonical base and extend it into Synal placement/browser surfaces rather than creating a new standalone system.

intent: Attach the Signal Composer control layer to Synal as the placement, browser, overlay and environment-aware interaction system. Ensure it works across browser text boxes, web apps, sticky/overlay surfaces, command palettes, email/calendar/chat entry points and away-from-keyboard capture.

thread_parse_delta.new_requirement: Because this involves place/browser/overlay behaviour, it belongs in the Synal grouping.
thread_parse_delta.operator_instruction: Do not start from zero. Reuse prior Signal Composer taxonomy, parser, router, dogfood scenarios and control tower design.
thread_parse_delta.meaning_of_place: The UI/control surface where the signal is composed, suggested, selected, overlaid, captured or routed — browser field, desktop overlay, chat thread, calendar title, email subject, meeting transcript, voice capture, watch, mobile share sheet, or command centre tile.

synal_extension_modules.name: Synal Placement Registry
synal_extension_modules.purpose: Canonical registry of where Signal Composer can appear: browser text box, email subject, calendar title, chat composer, docs header, sticky overlay, mobile share sheet, voice capture, meeting transcript, command centre widget.
synal_extension_modules.reuse: Consumes Signal Composer taxonomy and parser.

synal_extension_modules.name: Browser Overlay Injector
synal_extension_modules.purpose: Detect editable fields and offer compact Signal Composer chip, stepper, autocomplete or hidden power-user mode.
synal_extension_modules.reuse: Uses existing composer modes rather than inventing a new UX.

synal_extension_modules.name: Place-Aware Defaults
synal_extension_modules.purpose: Change default options by location: email defaults to Info/Decision/Action, calendar defaults to Review/Action, support defaults to Incident/Customer, launch pages default to Decision/Launch.
synal_extension_modules.reuse: Uses weighting engine and policy rules from parent job.

synal_extension_modules.name: Context Capture Adapter
synal_extension_modules.purpose: Capture page URL, app name, field label, selected text, transcript segment or screenshot reference as evidence metadata without overcollecting content.
synal_extension_modules.reuse: Binds to audit.signal_event and audit evidence states.

synal_extension_modules.name: Sticky/Overlay Surface
synal_extension_modules.purpose: Modern sticky-style signal cards that can sit over browser/desktop contexts and convert thoughts into structured signals, tasks, decisions or queue jobs.
synal_extension_modules.reuse: Routes through runtime.signal_queue; no standalone sticky database.

synal_extension_modules.name: Synal Control Tower Rollup
synal_extension_modules.purpose: Show signal load by place, tool, user, role, org, control tower and portfolio; expose stuck decisions, noisy surfaces and high-value routes.
synal_extension_modules.reuse: Extends cc.signal_widget_config and existing control tower model.

acceptance_criteria: Does not duplicate parent Signal Composer taxonomy/parser/router concepts
Every placement references a canonical place_key
Browser overlay can run in suggest-only mode before any write actions
Sticky overlay creates structured signal objects, not loose notes
Context capture stores source metadata without requiring screenshots/content unless explicitly allowed
All route writes are queued and idempotent
Control tower can show signal volume/value by place/surface/org/role
Deploy/RLS remains gated; read/inspect/enqueue can be autonomous
dogfood_validation: Use Signal Composer inside a browser text field to tag this Synal job
Use sticky overlay to capture a launch approval thought and route to Pen
Use calendar placement to schedule a review from a tag
Use meeting transcript extraction to identify decisions/actions
Show Synal control tower rollup for decisions vs actions vs noise by place

handoff.target: Pen first, then Symbio implementation branch; Synapse only after Gatekeeper validation.
handoff.next_worker_action: Build extension bundle by reusing parent job assets, creating placement registry schema and browser/sticky overlay components, then emit runtime receipt.
handoff.autonomy_tier: AUTO for inspect/enqueue/build assets; GATED for deploy/RLS/browser extension publication; BLOCKED for creds/payments/IAM/legal.
